notes: pair: construct + supertype Lens, each trimmed and folded like the room profile's pairs; a template is a lens whose subtype, trimmed and folded, is Template.
keys: the legal values of x_lens; a case's legal is what a reader's check answers, and bad names the first key refused (x_lens itself when the value is not an object).

text_only: a case marked text_only: true holds for a reader that can see a number's text (7.0 beside 7); a reader whose JSON parser gives one number type cannot tell them apart and may skip it, its why says so. Such a reader reads an integral float whole: a platform limit, not a rule.

worlds: each world's elements as its owner is served them, the ids its hidden mark keeps from every reader but the owner, and its readers. A reader's rung is owner (the whole world), contributor (the world less the hidden), guest (exactly the whole and known_of ids it lists; known_of is a stub) or public (the world less the hidden and the room elements). An element whose x_review_proposed holds any value but null is in no reader's view (the review profile's rule for a reader that hands a world on). A reader with as is the owner reading as that reader: the reader's view, and the owner's two counts (anchor_not_visible, not_visible).

resolve: lens is the lens read, a body or the id of a lens in the world; as_of is the reading's date (absent: the world's now; with neither, no fence and the window cuts nothing); clock is the reading's wall clock, for the mail rule and changed_within. kept is the resolved set in order, cut the count by reason (a reason with no count is absent). rows, where given, are the kept rows as show makes them; mail, where given, is the mail rule's part; notes_ignored counts notes on ids that are not anchors.

invariant: subset (each reader's kept is a subset of the owner's, and no secret's id or name appears anywhere in a non-owner result), same_without (each reader's result is identical with the without ids removed from the world), unchanged (the world is identical before and after every reader's reading).
uses: which lenses a seat reads, from its membership's choice (null: none made) and its Character's x_lens_uses.

graph: a case carries its own small world (the elements as the owner is served them, hidden: true on an element the hidden mark keeps, a room element by its pair and x_room_of, a proposed one by x_review_proposed) and reader (rung; a guest's whole and known_of; the owner's as), because the order case needs ids above U+FFFF that no uuid can carry; options are the graph's flags and lens (an id, or a lens body); want is the nodes in order with their marks, the edges in order, edges_cut, the lens's cut and unreadable; edges_cut_reasons lists every reason an edge can be cut by, the graph's own first, then a lens's; graph_links is the closed table of extension fields that make an edge.

reading_aid_mark.value: the id of the world the aid belongs to

cases.note: The Harbour Charter is a Law with supertype Charter and no x_charter_of: lore, kept by a lens with no types like any Law.

cases.name: a-reading-aid-anchor-is-followed-like-any-anchor
cases.note: The lens starts from the Reporting domain and no types: the domain is kept and its links are followed, so The Desk that names it is kept. A room anchor is never followed; a reading aid anchor is.

cases.name: a-hop-cuts-a-marked-charter-when-types-names-only-law

cases.name: changed-within-cuts-what-is-stale
cases.note: The Proof Sheet changed 3 days before the clock and is kept; the Old Plate 30 days before and is cut. The Bindery changed 40 days before and is kept: changed_within never applies to an anchor.

cases.name: umbrella-child-a-stub-is-not-entered
cases.note: The guest sees the umbrella whole and its child, Contacts, only as a stub: a stub carries no links and no x_lens, so the child is not entered, and its anchor, known of too, is never reached.

cases.name: umbrella-child-a-stub-is-the-owners-anchor-not-visible
cases.note: The owner reading as that guest counts the stub child as an anchor the view cannot see (rule 6).

cases.name: umbrella-child-whole-is-entered

cases.name: the-mail-part-reads-whole-messages-only-a-stub-is-not-to-everyone
cases.note: Known of is served as a stub, with no characters: it is never read as addressed to everyone. To everyone, whole with an empty list, is.

cases.name: an-anchor-cut-after-as-of-is-not-hopped-out-of
cases.note: The Late Treaty is dated 120, after the world's now of 100: cut, and Kell Dray, whom only it links, is not reached.

cases.name: depth-2-counts-no-room-element-or-reading-aid-its-types-would-not-keep
cases.note: Hop 2 from Bram Tull reaches Tull's Yard, a room line and a marked Domain; only the Yard is counted, since types (empty: any type, no room element, no reading aid) would keep neither of the other two.

cases.name: umbrella-child-keeps-its-own-budget-before-the-union
cases.note: Yard hands keeps two of its three anchors, its own budget, and counts the third budget in its own reading; the union then takes the umbrella's budget of 10, which cuts nothing more.

cases.name: umbrella-show-is-its-own-a-child-by-name-reads-in-full
cases.note: The rows are made once, from the union, by the umbrella's show: full, though the child says name.

cases.name: umbrella-show-is-its-own-a-child-in-full-reads-by-name
cases.note: The reverse: the umbrella says name, so the child's full reads as id, type and name.

cases.name: umbrella-a-childs-notes-never-reach-a-row

cases.name: umbrella-a-childs-mail-rule-takes-its-messages-out-uncounted
cases.note: The child's mail rule takes To everyone out of its kept; the umbrella's mail is none, so the message is neither kept, nor a mail part, nor counted.

cases.name: umbrella-a-siblings-lens-reached-by-a-hop-is-kept-as-an-element
cases.note: Gate desk enters Gate watch, then Gate roll. Gate watch's hop from Hale Orrin reaches Gate roll before it is entered, and keeps it as an element; Gate roll is then entered as the next child, and the union drops an element only by id, so Gate roll stays in the umbrella's kept: a lens is never in its own result, and Gate roll's own result is not this one. In the other link order Gate roll is entered first and the hop never reaches it.

cases.name: a-note-on-a-kept-element-that-is-not-an-anchor-is-ignored-and-counted
cases.note: Bram Tull is kept, one hop out, but is no anchor: his row carries no note and the note is counted.
